To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel single-ended to balanced power divider for differential feeding of circularly polarized antenna arrays, which can be used for wideband and high-gain applications.
a single-ended to balanced power divider is designed and implemented using slotline-to-microstrip transitions to achieve high common-mode rejection and low common-mode conversion.

a new type of differential feeding network comprising a single-ended-to-balanced power divider is presented and verified experimentally to be suitable to feed a differential circularly polarised antenna array with high gain, symetrical patterns and a wideband axial ratio.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of a new type and configuration of differential feeding networks for feeding differential CP arrays.
the design and development of differential feeding networks and their applications in feeding differential CP antenna arrays.
the development of a differential feeding network with high level of CM suppression and low DCM to CMC conversion levels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented differential power dividers and the differential antenna array can be used to provide a high gain and high efficiency differential CP antenna system with a wideband axial ratio bandwidth and symmetrical patterns.
the presented differential CP antenna array with the new differential feeding network has the advantages of high gain, wide axial ratio bandwidth, high common mode rejection and symmetrical patterns.
the presented feeding network is a very promising technique for differential CP antenna applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are able to design and implement a differential feeding network with high common-mode suppression level, which is able to feed a wideband CP antenna array with high level of isolation and high level of axial ratio bandwidth.
the presented differential antenna array fed by the new type of single-ended to balanced power divider with high common mode rejection can be used for wideband differential CP applications.
the presented differential antenna array can achieve 10.4dBi peak realized gain and 2.4:1 axial ratio bandwidth.

a wideband differential CP antenna array can be realized with high common mode rejection and low differential mode conversion using single-ended to balanced power divi
differential feeding networks with high level of suppression can be used to feed differential CP arrays to obtain high gain, symmetries in radiation patterns and wide axial ratio bandwidth.
differential feeding network with high common mode rejection can be used in CP arrays for high gain, wide bandwidth and low cross polarization applications.
